summary.en: Snell's law relates the angles of incidence and refraction to the refractive indices of the two materials: a ray bends more the greater the difference between them.
summary.et: Snelli seadus seob langemis- ja murdumisnurga kahe materjali murdumisnäitajatega: kiir murdub seda rohkem, mida suurem on nendevaheline erinevus.
